newsitem.title: USA: Chevron Calif. refinery up next week - source.
newsitem.headline: Chevron Calif. refinery up next week - source.

text.p: Chevron Corp expects to restart several units at its 225,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery in Richmond, Calif., next week, following spring maintenance shutdowns, said a source familiar with the plant.
"The plant should be back up next week at the lastest," said the source.
Shut units are the rhenaformer, TKN, and A-train, which came off line February 10 for maintenance work, the source said.
The plant continues to run at reduced capacity during the shutdown, he said, but did not know how much operations were scaled back.
